summary: fd_hosttest.c with 15 faults in private copies of rach2/sys/fs/fd.c and rach2/sys/proc/process.c, each a standard descriptor, a table growth or a description's lock or life handled against its rule

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${SRC}/rach2/sys -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I rach2/sys/fs tests/host/fd_hosttest.c ${SRC}/rach2/sys/fs/fd.c rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/fd_hosttest

faults.name: unchecked
faults.summary: ignores a failed allocation of a standard descriptor's description

faults.name: rollback
faults.summary: leaves the standard descriptors allocated before a failed one in the table

faults.name: process
faults.summary: publishes a process whose standard descriptors could not be made

faults.name: repoint
faults.summary: moves the handle of a description on any mounted type when a node moves, not KRFFS's alone

lines: mounted open handle remains stable during node relocation

faults.name: namespace
faults.summary: fd_ofd_lock and fd_ofd_unlock take the mount's namespace for KRFFS alone

lines: other mounted types take the namespace before the description

faults.name: unserialised
faults.summary: fd_ofd_lock and fd_ofd_unlock take the mount's namespace for every mounted file system, whether or not its type asks to be serialised

lines: a file system that needs no serialising takes no namespace lock

faults.name: alloc-description
faults.summary: answers -1 where a description the heap has no room for answers ENOMEM

lines: a description the heap has no room for is ENOMEM

faults.name: alloc-growth
faults.summary: answers -1 where a table the heap has no room to grow answers ENOMEM

lines: a table the heap has no room to grow is ENOMEM

faults.name: alloc-minimum
faults.summary: answers -1 where a minimum at the limit answers EMFILE

lines: a minimum at the limit is EMFILE

faults.name: alloc-limit
faults.summary: answers -1 where a table full to its limit answers EMFILE

lines: the process with a limit of 4 is held to it in the shared table

faults.name: reach-growth
faults.summary: answers -1 where a dup2 past the end of a table the heap cannot grow answers ENOMEM

lines: a dup2 past the end of a table the heap cannot grow is ENOMEM

faults.name: reach-range
faults.summary: answers -1 where a dup2 destination outside the limit answers EBADF

lines: a dup2 destination outside the limit is EBADF

faults.name: live-serial
faults.summary: fd_ofd_live calls a description open for a later serial than its own

lines: a description is not one with another serial

faults.name: live-closing
faults.summary: fd_ofd_live calls a description open while its last reference is closed

lines: a description its file system closes after its last reference is not open

faults.name: split-modes
faults.summary: opens fd 0 read-only and fds 1 and 2 write-only, where each is open for reading and writing

lines: each stdio descriptor is open for reading and writing
